scope: Evidence-only debugger loaded-data range/access map; not progress inventory, source-unit registration, or a linker section map.
range_convention: All ends exclusive. Scalar ranges are observed access footprints, not proof of independent original allocations. Unresolved gaps include possible alignment.
reference_limits: Symbolic low-operand references are a bounded static index, not complete pointer analysis. Address materialization is not a load/store. Indexed memory operands name the base, not necessarily the final address. Read-only use does not prove .rodata. Strings end at their first NUL, not at an inferred allocation end.
